migrationNotes: The page has no body prose beyond the two gallery headings and the line 'Check out the results of each event clicking on the banners below'.
Champion names in the gallery captions were read off the graphics themselves; the page text does not name anyone.
The dates on the four event cards were read off the banner artwork, not from page text.

Squarespace linked each banner to an anchor on the full-results page (#menssingles, #menspairs, #womenssingles, #womenpairs). Our template has no anchor targets, so each card links to the top of /2025-usplaydowns-full-results-1.
All images were already rescued into photos/archive/2025/ by the earlier archive pass and are referenced there; nothing was downloaded twice.
A /2025-usplaydowns rewrite still needs adding to vercel.json — outside the scope of this migration pass.
